title: Descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Half-Manasseh

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:1 (ESV): "The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel..."

questions.question: Why was Reuben’s birthright given to the sons of Joseph?
options: Because he defiled his father’s bed
questions.correctAnswer: Because he defiled his father’s bed
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:1 (ESV): "...because he defiled his father's couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph..."

questions.question: From whom came the chief ruler (prince), though the birthright belonged to Joseph?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:2 (ESV): "...though Judah became strong among his brothers and a chief came from him, yet the birthright belonged to Joseph."

questions.question: Who stirred up the spirit of Pul and Tilgath-pilneser kings of Assyria?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:26 (ESV): "So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria..."

questions.question: What happened to the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:26 (ESV): "...and he took them into exile... and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river Gozan, to this day."

questions.question: How many warriors did the two and a half tribes have?
Against whom did they make war?
options: The Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab
questions.correctAnswer: The Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:19 (ESV): "They made war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab."

questions.question: Why were they helped against their enemies?
options: Because they cried out to God in battle and trusted in him
questions.correctAnswer: Because they cried out to God in battle and trusted in him
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:20 (ESV): "...for they cried out to God in the battle, and he granted their plea because they trusted in him."

questions.question: Where did the Gadites live?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:16 (ESV): "They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasturelands of Sharon..."

questions.question: When were the genealogies of these tribes enrolled?
options: In the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: In the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:17 (ESV): "All of these were enrolled by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel."

questions.question: Who was Beerah?
options: A prince of the Reubenites whom Tiglath-pileser carried away
questions.correctAnswer: A prince of the Reubenites whom Tiglath-pileser carried away
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:6 (ESV): "Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried away into exile; he was a chieftain of the Reubenites."

questions.question: What limit did the children of Gad reach?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:11 (ESV): "The sons of Gad... as far as Salecah."

questions.question: Who were the heads of the fathers' houses of the half-tribe of Manasseh?
options: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel
questions.correctAnswer: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:24 (ESV): "These were the heads... Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel..."

questions.question: What happened to the gods of the peoples of the land?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:25 (ESV): "...and they whored after the gods of the peoples of the land..."

questions.question: How many camels were captured from the Hagrites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 5:21 (ESV): "They seized their livestock: of their camels 50,000..."

key_verse_text: And when they prevailed over them, the Hagrites and all who were with them were given into their hands, for they cried out to God in the battle, and he granted their plea because they trusted in him.
